items.name: accordion
items.description: Stacked sections that expand one at a time, or several at once.
items.useWhen: Several related sections where people usually need one or two at a time, such as FAQs or settings groups.
items.avoidWhen: The content is short enough to show at once, or people need to compare sections side by side.

items.name: alert
items.description: A message that stays on the page, with an optional icon.
items.useWhen: A message about the page or task that should stay visible, such as a warning or a status.
items.avoidWhen: The message is a response to an action and can go away on its own; use Toast.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.description: A modal that asks the user to confirm or cancel; clicking outside does not dismiss it.
items.useWhen: An action needs an explicit confirm or cancel, such as deleting something.
items.avoidWhen: The action is easy to undo; do it, and offer undo instead of asking.

items.name: analytics-dashboard
items.description: An analytics page with headline figures and sparklines, revenue over time, orders by channel, and a heatmap of when customers buy.
items.useWhen: A page of headline figures and charts that people scan for trends.
items.avoidWhen: The page is one chart or one figure; use Chart Card.

items.name: approval
items.description: Approve or deny a tool call before it runs.
items.useWhen: Asking the person to allow a tool or action before the agent runs it.
items.avoidWhen: Confirming ordinary form actions; use Alert Dialog.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.description: A box that keeps a width-to-height ratio, filled by its content.
items.useWhen: Images, video, maps, or embeds that must keep their shape as the layout resizes.
items.avoidWhen: The content has its own intrinsic size, such as an img with width and height set.

items.name: attachment
items.description: A file chip with a thumbnail or icon and a remove button.
items.useWhen: Showing a file the person is sending or has sent.
items.avoidWhen: A drop target; use Dropzone.

items.name: autocomplete
items.description: A text input with suggestions; the value is whatever the user types.
items.useWhen: People type free text and suggestions help, such as a search box or a tag input.
items.avoidWhen: The value must be one of a fixed list; use Combobox or Select.

items.name: avatar
items.description: A person's picture, with initials while it loads or if it fails. Includes a status badge and overlapping groups.
items.useWhen: Showing who a person or account is, in lists, comments, or headers.
items.avoidWhen: Representing things that aren't people or accounts; use an icon.

items.name: badge
items.description: A short status or count label.
items.useWhen: A short status, count, or category next to other content.
items.avoidWhen: The text is an action; use Button. Or it needs a sentence; use Alert.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.description: Where the current page sits in the site's hierarchy.
items.useWhen: Pages sit in a hierarchy more than two levels deep and people move up it.
items.avoidWhen: The site is flat, or the trail would only repeat the page title.

items.name: button
items.description: An action trigger with default, outline, secondary, ghost, destructive, and link variants.
items.useWhen: Triggering an action: submitting, saving, opening, or confirming.
items.avoidWhen: Navigating to another page; use a link, which can look like a Button.

items.name: button-group
items.description: Joins related Buttons into one row that shares borders.
items.useWhen: A few related actions that belong together, such as a split button or segmented actions.
items.avoidWhen: The buttons select a value; use Toggle Group.

items.name: calendar
items.description: A month grid for picking a single date, a range, or several dates, built on react-day-picker.
items.useWhen: A date needs to be picked from a visible month, such as a booking page or a range filter.
items.avoidWhen: People know the exact date and would rather type it; use Input with a date type.

items.name: card
items.description: A surface that groups related content.
items.useWhen: Grouping content about one thing, such as a summary, a setting, or an item in a grid.
items.avoidWhen: Every section of a page would be a card; use spacing and headings instead.

items.name: carousel
items.description: A slideshow built on Embla, composed from Root, Content, Item, Previous, and Next.
items.useWhen: A small set of related slides that people browse one at a time, such as product images.
items.avoidWhen: The content matters to everyone; put it on the page instead of behind a swipe.

items.name: chart
items.description: The shared parts of every chart: frame, grid, axes, tooltip, and a legend that hides series.
items.useWhen: Building any chart, or changing how every chart looks and reads.
items.avoidWhen: You only need one chart type; start from that chart's page.

items.name: chart-area
items.description: An area chart for trends over a range, with a soft fill under each line.
items.useWhen: Trends over a continuous range, such as revenue by month, where volume matters.
items.avoidWhen: Exact values matter more than shape; use a table, or a Line Chart for several close series.

items.name: chart-bar
items.description: A bar chart for comparing values across categories, grouped, stacked, or horizontal.
items.useWhen: Comparing values across categories, grouped, stacked, or horizontal.
items.avoidWhen: There are many categories with long names on a narrow screen, or parts of a whole; use a horizontal bar or Pie Chart.

items.name: chart-card
items.description: A card with a headline figure, its change, a date range switch, and an area chart.
items.useWhen: One headline figure with its trend and a chart, as a tile on a dashboard.
items.avoidWhen: You need a full page of reporting; use Analytics Dashboard.

items.name: chart-funnel
items.description: A funnel chart for drop-off through ordered steps.
items.useWhen: Drop-off through ordered steps, such as visit, signup, purchase.
items.avoidWhen: The steps are not ordered or do not narrow; use a Bar Chart.

items.name: chart-heatmap
items.description: A heatmap for intensity across two categories, as an accessible table of tinted cells.
items.useWhen: Intensity across two categories, such as orders by weekday and hour.
items.avoidWhen: There are only a few values; use a table or Bar Chart.

items.name: chart-line
items.description: A line chart for change over a range, with one or more series.
items.useWhen: Change over a range where the line matters more than the area, or several series that overlap.
items.avoidWhen: Parts of a whole over time; use stacked Area Chart.

items.name: chart-pie
items.description: A pie or donut chart for the parts of a whole, with an optional total in the middle.
items.useWhen: The parts of a whole, for up to six slices, with a total in the middle of a donut.
items.avoidWhen: More than six slices, or slices that are close in size; use a Bar Chart.

items.name: chart-radar
items.description: A radar chart for comparing a few series across the same axes.
items.useWhen: Comparing a few series across five to eight shared axes.
items.avoidWhen: Fewer than five axes, or axes that are not comparable; use a Bar Chart.

items.name: chart-radial
items.description: A radial chart for progress toward a goal, or a few values on concentric rings.
items.useWhen: Progress toward a goal, or a few values on concentric rings.
items.avoidWhen: A single value in a range; Meter or Progress is simpler.

items.name: chart-sankey
items.description: A sankey chart for flow between stages.
items.useWhen: Flow between stages, such as visitors to signups to paid.
items.avoidWhen: There is no flow between stages; use a Bar Chart or Funnel Chart.

items.name: chart-scatter
items.description: A scatter chart for how two measures relate, with optional dot size for a third.
items.useWhen: How two measures relate, one dot per item, with dot size for a third.
items.avoidWhen: Categories on one axis; use a Bar Chart.

items.name: chart-treemap
items.description: A treemap for sizes within a whole, as nested rectangles.
items.useWhen: Sizes within a whole, as nested rectangles, such as storage by folder.
items.avoidWhen: Precise comparison; areas are harder to compare than bars.

items.name: chat
items.description: A complete chat: scrolling conversation with streaming markdown, a message box with attachments, and send that becomes stop.
items.useWhen: A conversation with an assistant that streams its replies.
items.avoidWhen: The conversation is not with an agent, or is a single prompt box; use Composer.

items.name: checkbox
items.description: A checkbox with checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states.
items.useWhen: A single on/off choice in a form that takes effect on submit.
items.avoidWhen: The setting takes effect immediately; use Switch.

items.name: checkbox-group
items.description: Shares one array value between a set of Checkboxes, with optional select-all.
items.useWhen: Choosing any number of options from a short list.
items.avoidWhen: Only one option may be chosen; use Radio Group.

items.name: citation
items.description: A numbered marker in an answer that links to its source and previews it on hover.
items.useWhen: A numbered source marker inside generated text.
items.avoidWhen: A list of everything the answer used; use Sources.

items.name: code-block
items.description: A code listing with a copy button; syntax highlighting loads on demand.
items.useWhen: Showing a code listing, such as a model's answer or an example, with a copy button.
items.avoidWhen: The code is editable; use an editor. Inline code belongs in running text.

items.name: collapsible
items.description: A section that shows and hides its panel.
items.useWhen: One section of secondary detail that people can reveal.
items.avoidWhen: There are several sections that behave as a set; use Accordion.

items.name: color-picker
items.description: Swatches to choose from and a hex field for any other color. No canvas, no dependencies.
items.useWhen: Choosing a color from a few swatches or by hex value.
items.avoidWhen: Picking from gradients or an image; this has no canvas.

items.name: combobox
items.description: Picks a value from a list you can filter by typing.
items.useWhen: Choosing from a long list where typing to filter is faster than scrolling.
items.avoidWhen: The list has only a few options; use Select or Radio Group.

items.name: command
items.description: A searchable command list with groups, shortcuts, and an empty state, inline or in a dialog.
items.useWhen: A searchable list of actions or destinations, such as a command palette on ⌘K.
items.avoidWhen: There are only a few options; use Dropdown Menu or Select.

items.name: composer
items.description: The message box for a chat: a text field that becomes a Tiptap editor on demand, file attachments, and send that turns into stop.
items.useWhen: The message box of a chat: send on Enter, attach files by drop, paste, or picker, and stop a reply in progress.
items.avoidWhen: A single-line field for short answers; use Input.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.description: Asks before an action that is hard to undo, then runs it. Shows a pending state while it runs, and keeps the dialog open with the error if it fails.
items.useWhen: An action is hard to undo and runs asynchronously, such as deleting a project. It disables the buttons while it runs and shows the failure.
items.avoidWhen: The action is easy to undo; do it and offer undo. The dialog holds other content such as a form; compose Dialog.

items.name: context-menu
items.description: A menu opened by right-clicking or long-pressing an area.
items.useWhen: Offering shortcuts for an item on right-click or long-press, such as rows or canvas objects.
items.avoidWhen: It is the only way to reach an action; right-click isn't discoverable, so offer a visible menu too.

items.name: copy-button
items.description: A button that copies text to the clipboard and briefly shows a check, plus the useCopy hook behind it.
items.useWhen: Copying a snippet, command, or message to the clipboard.
items.avoidWhen: Copying rich or large data that needs a progress state.

items.name: dashboard-overview
items.description: A dashboard home with headline stats, a revenue chart, progress toward goals, and recent invoices.
items.useWhen: The home page of an app, with key figures and recent activity.
items.avoidWhen: The page is about one subject in depth; use Analytics Dashboard.

items.name: dashboard-shell
items.description: An app shell with pinned and recent items in the sidebar, a ⌘K command palette, and an account menu.
items.useWhen: The frame of a product with sidebar navigation, search, and an account menu.
items.avoidWhen: The navigation has sub-pages; use Sidebar Nested.

items.name: data-table
items.description: A TanStack Table data table with sorting, filtering, row selection, pagination, and column visibility, built on Table.
items.useWhen: Rows people need to sort, filter, select, and page through, such as invoices or users.
items.avoidWhen: The data is short and read-only, use Table. Thousands of rows that should scroll instead of page, use Data Table Virtual.

items.name: data-table-virtual
items.description: A TanStack Table data table that scrolls and renders only the rows in view, for thousands of rows.
items.useWhen: Thousands of rows that people sort, filter, and select in one scrolling list.
items.avoidWhen: A few hundred rows or fewer, or people expect pages; use Data Table.

items.name: date-picker
items.description: A button that opens a Calendar in a Popover to pick a date or a date range.
items.useWhen: A form field for a date or a date range that should stay compact until opened.
items.avoidWhen: The calendar should always be visible; use Calendar.

items.name: dialog
items.description: A modal window composed from Root, Trigger, Content, Header, Footer, Title, Description, and Close.
items.useWhen: A focused task that needs the rest of the page out of the way, such as a form or a detail view.
items.avoidWhen: The content could live on the page, or the dialog would open another dialog.

items.name: drawer
items.description: A modal panel that slides in from any edge of the screen and can be swiped away.
items.useWhen: A bottom sheet on mobile, or a side panel for filters, details, or an edit form next to the page.
items.avoidWhen: The task needs full attention and a clear decision; use Dialog or Alert Dialog.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.description: A menu of actions opened from a button, with checkbox, radio, and submenu items.
items.useWhen: A list of actions behind one trigger, such as an overflow menu.
items.avoidWhen: People pick a value from options; use Select.

items.name: dropzone
items.description: A drop target for files with a picker, a drag overlay, and readable rejections.
items.useWhen: People add files by dragging them onto the page or choosing them, with limits on type and size.
items.avoidWhen: The file is a single form field with no drag and drop; use a plain file Input.

items.name: editor
items.description: A block editor on Tiptap: headings, lists, task lists, quotes, code, links, and highlights.
items.useWhen: A rich-text document: headings, lists, tasks, quotes, code, and links in one place.
items.avoidWhen: A single-line field or short message; use Textarea or Composer.

items.name: editor-block-handle
items.description: A drag handle beside each block, with a menu to turn it into another block, duplicate, or delete it.
items.useWhen: Blocks need to be reordered by dragging, or turned into another kind, duplicated, or deleted.
items.avoidWhen: The document is a single paragraph.

items.name: editor-bubble-menu
items.description: A floating toolbar over selected text for bold, italic, link, highlight, and turning a block into another type.
items.useWhen: Formatting should appear over selected text instead of in a fixed toolbar.
items.avoidWhen: A fixed toolbar above the document is wanted; compose Toolbar instead.

items.name: editor-link-popover
items.description: A popover to add, edit, open, and remove a link on the selected text.
items.useWhen: People add, change, or remove a link on selected text.
items.avoidWhen: Links are shown, not edited; use a plain anchor.

items.name: editor-slash-menu
items.description: A searchable menu opened by typing / at the start of a block, to insert headings, lists, quotes, code, and dividers.
items.useWhen: People insert blocks by typing / in a line.
items.avoidWhen: Mentions or other trigger characters; use Editor Suggestion.

items.name: editor-suggestion
items.description: A menu that opens on a trigger character in a Tiptap editor: @ for mentions, / for commands. Async-safe and keyboard-driven.
items.useWhen: A menu that opens when a trigger character is typed in a Tiptap editor, such as @ for mentions.
items.avoidWhen: Block commands from a slash; use Editor Slash Menu.

items.name: empty
items.description: An empty state with media, a title, a description, and actions.
items.useWhen: A list, table, or page has nothing to show yet, and people need to know what to do next.
items.avoidWhen: The content is still loading; use Skeleton or Spinner.

items.name: field
items.description: Groups a control with its label, description, and error, and wires up accessibility and validation.
items.useWhen: Any form control that needs a label, a description, and an error message.
items.avoidWhen: The control has no label or validation, such as a search input in a toolbar.

items.name: fieldset
items.description: Groups related fields under a legend; disabling it disables every field inside.
items.useWhen: Grouping related fields under one legend, such as an address.
items.avoidWhen: There is only one field; use Field.

items.name: form
items.description: A form that validates its Fields together and focuses the first invalid one on submit.
items.useWhen: Collecting input with validation and one submit action.
items.avoidWhen: Each control saves on its own; use the controls directly.

items.name: foundations
items.description: Semantic StyleX variables for color, typography, spacing, radius, elevation, and motion, named media queries and layers, plus a dark theme and the typefaces.
items.useWhen: Always. Every other item depends on it.

items.name: hover-card
items.description: A preview of a link's destination, shown while a pointer rests on the link.
items.useWhen: A preview of a linked thing on hover, such as a profile behind a name.
items.avoidWhen: The content is needed to complete a task; hover isn't available on touch, so use Popover.

items.name: icons
items.description: The icons Shelf components use, in one file you own. lucide-react by default; swap the imports to change libraries.
items.useWhen: Supporting a label with a familiar symbol, or marking state.
items.avoidWhen: The icon would be the only label for an unfamiliar action; add text or a Tooltip.

items.name: input
items.description: A text input that takes part in a Field's label, description, and validation.
items.useWhen: Short single-line text such as a name, an email, or a search.
items.avoidWhen: The text can span lines; use Textarea. Or it is a number with steps; use Number Field.

items.name: input-group
items.description: An input with text, icons, or buttons attached inside its border.
items.useWhen: An input with attached content, such as a prefix, an icon, or an inline button.
items.avoidWhen: The attached content is a separate action; place a Button next to the input.

items.name: input-otp
items.description: A one-time code input with one slot per character and paste support.
items.useWhen: Entering a one-time code of fixed length.
items.avoidWhen: The code length varies, or people will paste long tokens; use Input.

items.name: invoices-table
items.description: An invoices list with status tabs and counts, search, bulk actions on selected rows, and a running total.
items.useWhen: A list people filter, search, and act on in bulk.
items.avoidWhen: The rows are not records that need status, search, and bulk actions; use Data Table.

items.name: item
items.description: A list row of media, a title, a description, and actions, that can render as a link.
items.useWhen: Rows of media, text, and actions in a list, such as members, files, or settings.
items.avoidWhen: The rows need columns people compare across; use Table.

items.name: kbd
items.description: A keyboard key.
items.useWhen: Showing a keyboard shortcut or key in text or menus.
items.avoidWhen: The text is code; use a code element.

items.name: label
items.description: A text label for a form control.
items.useWhen: Naming a form control, when you aren't using Field.
items.avoidWhen: You are using Field, which renders its own label.

items.name: list-detail-page
items.description: A list beside the selected record's details, with a confirmed delete and an empty state. Start from it for projects, customers, or any collection.
items.useWhen: People pick a record from a collection and work on it beside the list, such as projects or customers.
items.avoidWhen: The list is large or needs sorting and columns; use Data Table.

items.name: login-form
items.description: A sign-in card with email and password fields, validation, a pending state, and SSO.
items.useWhen: A sign-in card that sits inside a page you lay out.
items.avoidWhen: The sign-in is the whole page; use Login Split.

items.name: login-split
items.description: A full-page sign-in with a brand panel and quote beside the login form.
items.useWhen: A whole sign-in page with room for brand.
items.avoidWhen: The sign-in sits in an existing page; use Login Form.

items.name: menubar
items.description: A row of menus, as in a desktop app, with arrow-key movement between them.
items.useWhen: Application-style menus across the top of a tool, such as File, Edit, and View.
items.avoidWhen: A website's main navigation; use Navigation Menu.

items.name: message
items.description: One turn in a conversation: unboxed assistant text, a user bubble, and hover actions.
items.useWhen: One turn in a conversation, from the person or the assistant, with actions on hover.
items.avoidWhen: A notification or status; use Alert or Toast.

items.name: meter
items.description: A measurement within a known range, such as storage used.
items.useWhen: A value within a known range, such as storage used or a score.
items.avoidWhen: Progress toward finishing a task; use Progress.

items.name: native-select
items.description: The browser's own select, styled to match Input and Select, with option groups.
items.useWhen: A simple choice on mobile, or where the browser's own picker is the better experience.
items.avoidWhen: Options need icons, descriptions, or search; use Select or Combobox.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.description: Site navigation where items open panels of links in one shared surface.
items.useWhen: Top-level site navigation, with optional panels of links.
items.avoidWhen: Menus of actions inside an app; use Dropdown Menu or Menubar.

items.name: number-field
items.description: A number input with step buttons, keyboard stepping, and locale-aware formatting.
items.useWhen: A number people adjust in steps, such as a quantity.
items.avoidWhen: The value is an identifier that happens to be digits, such as a phone number; use Input.

items.name: number-ticker
items.description: A number that counts to its new value when it changes, and reads out the final value for screen readers.
items.useWhen: A figure that changes while the person watches, such as a live total.
items.avoidWhen: Numbers that change every frame.

items.name: otp-verification
items.description: A card that asks for a six-digit code, with verify and resend actions.
items.useWhen: Asking for a six-digit code after sign-in or before a sensitive action.
items.avoidWhen: The code is one field inside a longer form; use Input OTP.

items.name: pagination
items.description: Links between the pages of a long list.
items.useWhen: Moving through pages of results when position matters, such as tables.
items.avoidWhen: People scan a feed; load more as they scroll instead.

items.name: plan
items.description: An agent's plan as steps that are not started, in progress, or done.
items.useWhen: Showing the steps an agent intends to take and how far it has got.
items.avoidWhen: A user's progress through a flow; use Stepper.

items.name: popover
items.description: Rich, interactive content in a floating panel opened from a button.
items.useWhen: Interactive content anchored to a trigger, such as a small form or filters.
items.avoidWhen: The content is a short label; use Tooltip. Or a list of actions; use Dropdown Menu.

items.name: progress
items.description: How far along a task is, or that it is in progress.
items.useWhen: Showing how far a task has gone, such as an upload.
items.avoidWhen: The duration is unknown and short; use Spinner.

items.name: radio-group
items.description: A set of options where exactly one can be chosen, with arrow-key navigation.
items.useWhen: Choosing exactly one option from a short list where all options should be visible.
items.avoidWhen: There are many options; use Select or Combobox.

items.name: rating
items.description: A star rating built as a radio group, or a read-only display of an average.
items.useWhen: Collecting or showing a star rating.
items.avoidWhen: A value on a wide scale; use Slider.

items.name: reasoning
items.description: The model's thinking, open while it streams and folded away when done.
items.useWhen: Showing a model's thinking while it works, then folding it away.
items.avoidWhen: Content the reader must see; put it in the message.

items.name: resizable
items.description: Panels resized by dragging or the keyboard, composed from Group, Panel, and Handle.
items.useWhen: Side-by-side panes whose size people adjust, such as an editor and a preview.
items.avoidWhen: The layout works at fixed sizes; resizing adds a control nobody asked for.

items.name: scroll-area
items.description: A native scrolling region with thin, themed scrollbars.
items.useWhen: A region with its own scroll that should look consistent across platforms.
items.avoidWhen: The whole page scrolls; let the browser handle it.

items.name: select
items.description: Picks one value from a list of options.
items.useWhen: Choosing one value from a list of about five to fifteen options.
items.avoidWhen: There are only two or three options; use Radio Group. Or many; use Combobox.

items.name: separator
items.description: A horizontal or vertical dividing line.
items.useWhen: Dividing groups of content or menu items.
items.avoidWhen: Spacing alone would separate the groups.

items.name: settings-page
items.description: A settings page: a profile section and a danger zone that confirms before deleting the account. Start from it and add the sections your product has.
items.useWhen: A whole account or workspace settings screen with a danger zone.
items.avoidWhen: The page is one section inside an existing screen; use Settings Section.

items.name: settings-section
items.description: A profile settings section with text fields, a notification switch, and Save and Cancel.
items.useWhen: One group of account or profile settings with Save and Cancel.
items.avoidWhen: The page holds several sections; start from Settings Page.

items.name: shimmer
items.description: Text with a soft highlight sweeping across it, for work in progress.
items.useWhen: A short label for work in progress, such as Thinking, where a spinner would be too loud.
items.avoidWhen: Progress that has a known amount; use Progress.

items.name: sidebar
items.description: An app-shell sidebar that collapses offcanvas or to icons and becomes a sheet on small screens.
items.useWhen: The main navigation of an app, collapsible on desktop and a sheet on mobile.
items.avoidWhen: A site with a few top-level pages; use Navigation Menu.

items.name: sidebar-nested
items.description: An app shell whose sidebar sections expand into sub-pages, and open as menus when collapsed to icons.
items.useWhen: An app whose navigation has sections that open into sub-pages.
items.avoidWhen: The navigation is flat; use Dashboard Shell.

items.name: signup-form
items.description: A sign-up card with name, email, and password fields, a terms checkbox, and a pending state.
items.useWhen: A registration card that sits inside a page you lay out.
items.avoidWhen: People already have an account; use Login Form.

items.name: skeleton
items.description: A placeholder shape while content loads.
items.useWhen: Holding the shape of content while it loads, so the layout doesn't jump.
items.avoidWhen: Loading takes a moment and has no layout to hold; use Spinner.

items.name: slider
items.description: A draggable input for a single value or a range.
items.useWhen: Choosing an approximate value in a range, such as volume.
items.avoidWhen: The exact value matters; use Number Field.

items.name: sources
items.description: The pages an answer drew on, folded under Used N sources.
items.useWhen: Listing what an answer was based on.
items.avoidWhen: A single inline reference; use Citation.

items.name: sparkline
items.description: A tiny line with no axes, for a table cell or a stat.
items.useWhen: A tiny trend beside a number, in a stat or a table row.
items.avoidWhen: The values themselves matter; use an Area Chart or Line Chart with axes.

items.name: spinner
items.description: A spinning loading indicator.
items.useWhen: A short wait with no known duration.
items.avoidWhen: The wait has a known progress; use Progress. Or content has a shape; use Skeleton.

items.name: stat
items.description: A key figure with a label and its change since the last period.
items.useWhen: Showing one key figure with its label and change.
items.avoidWhen: A trend over time; use a chart or Sparkline.

items.name: stepper
items.description: Progress through a multi-step flow, with the current step marked for assistive technology.
items.useWhen: Showing where someone is in a multi-step flow such as checkout.
items.avoidWhen: An agent's plan; use Plan. Tabbed content; use Tabs.

items.name: stream
items.description: Streamdown-style streaming markdown: only the growing block re-renders, and output is safe by default.
items.useWhen: Showing model output as it streams in, with safe links, images off by default, and highlighted code.
items.avoidWhen: Authoring rich text; use an editor.

items.name: switch
items.description: An on/off control that takes effect immediately.
items.useWhen: A setting that takes effect immediately.
items.avoidWhen: The choice is saved on submit; use Checkbox.

items.name: table
items.description: A semantic HTML table with Shelf styles.
items.useWhen: Data people compare across rows and columns.
items.avoidWhen: Content is a list of items with one or two attributes; use a list.

items.name: tabs
items.description: Switches between panels of related content.
items.useWhen: Switching between views of the same context, one at a time.
items.avoidWhen: People need to compare views, or the tabs navigate between pages.

items.name: textarea
items.description: A multi-line text input that grows with its content and takes part in a Field.
items.useWhen: Multi-line text such as comments or descriptions.
items.avoidWhen: The text is a single line; use Input.

items.name: thread
items.description: A conversation's scroll area: follows new messages, lets go when you scroll up, and brings you back with one button.
items.useWhen: The scroll area of a conversation that grows over time, following new messages until the reader scrolls up.
items.avoidWhen: A static list that never grows; use a normal scroll area.

items.name: time-picker
items.description: Hours and minutes as number fields, with an AM/PM list in 12-hour mode. Pairs with date-picker.
items.useWhen: Choosing a time of day. Pair it with Date Picker for a date and time.
items.avoidWhen: A duration; use Number Field.

items.name: timeline
items.description: Events in order, joined by a line, with a title, time, and description.
items.useWhen: Events in order, such as a release history or an activity log.
items.avoidWhen: A flow with a current step; use Stepper.

items.name: toast
items.description: Brief notifications queued from anywhere in the app: stacked, swipeable, with success, error, and loading states.
items.useWhen: Brief feedback after an action, such as saved or copied.
items.avoidWhen: The message needs action or must stay; use Alert or Dialog.

items.name: toggle
items.description: A two-state button with default and outline variants.
items.useWhen: A single on/off button in a toolbar, such as bold.
items.avoidWhen: The setting is part of a form; use Switch or Checkbox.

items.name: toggle-group
items.description: A set of Toggles sharing one value, with arrow-key navigation.
items.useWhen: Choosing one or several options shown as buttons, such as text alignment.
items.avoidWhen: The options need labels longer than a word; use Radio Group.

items.name: tool-call
items.description: A tool call with its status, input, and output, collapsed by default.
items.useWhen: Showing an agent's tool use with its state, input, and output.
items.avoidWhen: A final answer; use Message.

items.name: toolbar
items.description: A row of controls that is one Tab stop, with arrow-key movement.
items.useWhen: A set of controls that act on the same thing, such as an editor.
items.avoidWhen: The controls are unrelated; keep them separate.

items.name: tooltip
items.description: A short label shown on hover and keyboard focus.
items.useWhen: A short label for an icon-only control or a truncated value.
items.avoidWhen: The content is essential or interactive; tooltips don't appear on touch, so use Popover or visible text.

items.name: tree-view
items.description: A keyboard-navigable hierarchy such as a file list, with open and close branches and a single selection.
items.useWhen: A hierarchy to browse and select from, such as files.
items.avoidWhen: Navigation between pages; use Sidebar or Navigation Menu.

items.name: typography
items.description: Prose styles for headings, paragraphs, lead text, quotes, lists, and inline code.
items.useWhen: Long-form text such as docs, articles, or changelogs that needs consistent prose styles.
items.avoidWhen: Interface labels and short text; use the components' own text styles.

items.name: usage-explorer
items.description: Charts of where registry items are installed, what state each copy is in, and how far behind it has drifted, from shelf usage output.
items.useWhen: Showing how far the products have drifted from the registry, from `shelf usage` output.
items.avoidWhen: Anywhere that isn't reporting on Shelf itself.

items.name: utils
items.description: Shared types and helpers used by Shelf components.
items.useWhen: Always. Components import its helpers.
